name: VoidMob
description: Mobile 4G/5G proxies, non-VoIP carrier SMS verification, dedicated numbers, and eSIM data plans (180+ destinations) on one prepaid balance. Open-source MCP server with 28 tools across 6 categories. No KYC. Sandbox mode with $500 play-money balance requires no API key.

agent_endpoints.auth_note: API key (vmk_live_...) self-serve from the dashboard, set as VOIDMOB_API_KEY. Purchases draw down a prepaid balance funded with crypto on the dashboard — the funding step is not agent-callable. Set VOIDMOB_SANDBOX=1 for a keyless $500 mock balance. No documented REST API; MCP is the agent surface.
